title: 1920s Young Woman in Middy Blouse, Vintage Sepia Outdoor Snapshot Photo
description: A full-length vintage 1920s snapshot of a young woman posing outdoors in front of a leafy bush. She wears a sailor-collar middy blouse with a knotted dark scarf, paired with a pleated mid-length skirt, light stockings, and classic strap pumps. This casual sportswear style was immensely popular among school-age girls and young women in the post-WWI 1920s era.
